value.rationale: Palindromic length is an established string-decomposition invariant. Among equal-coverage cyclic de Bruijn words, a complete classification of how changing cycle and root affects the minimum is structurally motivated and genuinely discriminating: best-root lengths range sharply from four to nine, worst-root lengths reach ten, and the two hardest cycles form a single reversal/complement symmetry pair. The exact complete 2,048-cycle benchmark is a meaningful finite classification rather than an arbitrary parameter slice; no higher-order theorem is asserted.
